title: Editor E8 slice: accept and dismiss telemetry for Vera's questions, and the Vera-path tool readers on a schema
detail:
Split from PROG-E8 on 2026-11-16. Two of the row's REMAINS items, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS, no migration, no model call in any test.

TELEMETRY (EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE 8.1 item 8). lib/analytics/events.ts registers editor.vera_question_accepted and editor.vera_question_dismissed (feature, client-emittable). Each question in components/builder/inspector/vera-block-coach.tsx now has two controls and still no field of its own: Answer this moves the cursor to that field in the inspector beside her (it focuses, it never types), Not now puts the question away. Each fires its event once per question. The payload is built by one pure function (lib/builder/vera-coach.ts veraQuestionProps): blockType, field key, questionId, source (vera or fallback), position and shown. No wording, no label, no field content, nothing about a person. BlockQuestion now carries its questionId and BlockCoaching its blockType so the client has ids to send. FIRST-PARTY ONLY: both names sit in a block list in lib/analytics/sanitize.ts and both Google mirrors ask pixelAllowsEvent first (the browser gtag in track-provider.tsx, the server Measurement Protocol in track.ts), so the events reach the engagement ledger and no pixel, whoever calls. lib/analytics/client-event-delivery.test.ts proves it end to end with the real tracker, collector and ledger recorder, plus a control showing an ordinary event still mirrors.

SCHEMA READS (the ADR-1287 pattern, lib/ai/schema.ts validateModelValue). Five hand-written readers over tool_use inputs outside lib/ai now parse through a zod schema, with the same result on a valid reply and the same fail-closed value on anything else: parseBlockCoaching (lib/builder/vera-coach.ts, strict: any unknown field, id, extra key or count rejects the whole reply), coerceSuggestions and coerceExtracted (lib/crm/import/ai.ts, Vera's CSV mapping and contact extraction), coerceDemographic (lib/importer/reframe/demographic.ts) and coerceVerdict (lib/importer/verify/refute.ts). lib/ai/schema.ts gains two shared blocks they are built from, textOrEmpty and lenientList.

VERIFIED: unit tests for the catalog, the pixel block (browser and server), the coach's two controls and payload, each converted reader on valid and malformed input; lint; scoped typecheck; contract guards. NOT VERIFIED: nothing was clicked in a browser (the canvas is staff-only and dark), and no row was read back from the production engagement ledger.

NOT DONE HERE, and why. The count_tokens and cache read/write reading on /admin/ai was stopped: the split is not stored anywhere (ai_settle_attempt folds cache reads and writes into input_tokens, and ai_usage has no cache columns), so showing it needs two columns and a changed RPC, which is a migration this PR was told not to write. Readers left on hand-written ladders, outside the Vera and builder paths: lib/whatsapp/extract.ts coerceItem and its event and housing readers, lib/importer/extract/run.ts coerceExtraction, lib/importer/vision.ts (inline), lib/listing-seeder/coerce.ts coerceListingExtraction, lib/launch/buildout.ts applyPolish, lib/connections/normalize.ts coerceExtraction, lib/events/normalize.ts coerceEventDetails.

verify.note: Fails on main: neither event is registered, nothing bars an event from the pixels, the coach fires nothing, and the five readers walk the raw input by hand. Passes once the events are in the catalog and the first-party-only set, both mirrors ask pixelAllowsEvent, the coach fires the registered event with the ids-only payload, each reader goes through validateModelValue, and the tests exist.
